name: Simon C. Simon
bio:
Jambo! I'm Simon, a big cat enthusiast with a particular love for male lions. Driven by my passion for wildlife, I attended Prots Institute College in Arusha to study tour guiding and wildlife courses. In 2019, I took my first step toward living my dream by joining the Mazingira Safaris guide team.
I've earned a reputation as one of the top safari guides in Tanzania's Northern Circuit parks.
I am Dedicated to learning new things, exploring new opportunities, and introducing fresh ideas to the company, I always strive to work hard. My extensive knowledge, skills, and experience have consistently garnered positive feedback from my clients, which fills me with pride.
I welcome you to Tanzania for the best wildlife safaris, cultural experiences, and more that this beautiful country offers. Karibuni!
